summary: AstroVital is an interactive astronaut wellness platform designed to support the physical, cognitive, and emotional well-being of astronauts during extended space missions. It combines personalized health monitoring, NASA data integrations, gamification, cognitive exercises, and personal wellness tracking into one centralized platform. Its goal is to make astronaut health monitoring more accessible, engaging, and proactive while encouraging consistent wellness habits throughout a mission.
details:
Dashboard and Health Monitoring: Provides an overview of astronaut wellness through heart rate, sleep, exercise, fatigue, hydration, medication, and nutrition tracking. Its 30-day personal baseline feature helps users identify changes in their individual health patterns over time.

NASA Data Integration: Incorporates publicly available NASA resources, including NASA POWER for environmental and solar data, historical International Space Station telemetry, and NASA's Open Science Data Repository (OSDR) for spaceflight-related research datasets.

Rufus and Daily Missions: Introduces Rufus, an astronaut companion designed to make wellness more engaging. Users can complete daily objectives, earn experience points, maintain streaks, and unlock achievements through gamification.

Mind Lab: Provides three interactive cognitive activities: Memory, Reaction, and Attention. These exercises encourage users to practice cognitive skills through short, engaging challenges.

Wellbeing: Allows users to record their mood, fatigue, stress, and personal reflections through wellness check-ins and an optional journal. Journal entries are stored locally in the user's browser to support personal privacy.

Privacy and Personalization: Emphasizes individual health patterns rather than relying exclusively on generalized averages. Personal journal entries remain in local browser storage rather than being transmitted to an AstroVital server.
